scope: Existing Home header only; no full Home runtime or life service replacement.

sourceHeader.avatarPanelSeparation: Preserve approved R2 runtime slices and connector; never draw whole atlas behind a selected portrait.
sourceHeader.frameDisplay: Square of headerWidth * 0.17; left aligned; centered vertically; independent of 400px atlas extraction bounds.

coordinates: Header-local top-left logical UI units; w=existing header width; h=w*360/2121. Preserve current safe-area-aware header geometry.

lifeCount.format: Live text. Do not bake numbers into textures.

timer.formatAtLeastHour: H:MM:SS, hide clock to reserve text width
timer.full: Localized Full; hide clock; no refill deadline.
timer.waiting: Clock + ellipsis when below cap and awaiting authoritative timestamp/balance; do not show an invented time.

touch.behavior: Use existing Lives / refill flow. No automatic purchase or new modal in this delivery.

avatar: Current profile service remains responsible; review shows approved original fallback, not a replacement portrait.
responsive: Same HomeLayoutEngine header formulas as approved R2. Tested 320,393,430,768 portrait widths and 844 landscape. Apply safe area before calculating frame. Keep text live on the existing full-resolution UI canvas.
decorativeHeart: The main heart is baked into the approved wallet panel. Do not animate another heart directly over it. A separate R3_Lives sprite is used only for the departing/arriving feedback.
